description: Defines an internal interface IMemberDescription for describing members in code generation within the Orleans project, and a sealed class MemberDescriptionTypeComparer for comparing IMemberDescription instances.

classes.name: IMemberDescription
classes.description: An internal interface that exposes metadata about a member (such as fields or properties), including type information, symbol info, and serialization attributes.

classes.name: MemberDescriptionTypeComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IEqualityComparer<IMemberDescription> for comparing member descriptions based on type name and assembly name.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether two IMemberDescription objects are equal based on their TypeName and AssemblyName.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an IMemberDescription object based on its TypeName and AssemblyName.
